findings.evidence: The local proof immediately converts the domain hypothesis to uniqueness at lines 272-276; later uses only call that uniqueness result (`have h_unique := ...` at line 290, `exact disjoint...` at line 337, and line 472).
findings.fix: State the general lemmas with `[Unique (minimalPrimes (X.presheaf.stalk x))]` or `∀ x, Unique (minimalPrimes (Z.presheaf.stalk x))`, then derive the current `IsDomain` versions as corollaries using `IsDomain.minimalPrimes_eq_singleton_bot`.
findings.issue: `unique_irreducibleComponent_of_isDomain_stalk` and its downstream public corollaries at lines 281, 340, and 467 assume `IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)`, but the proof only uses `Unique (minimalPrimes (X.presheaf.stalk x))`.

summary: The main public API proves the domain-stalk special case directly instead of first stating the natural minimal-prime uniqueness result. This makes the reusable topology unnecessarily narrow.
